---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible problem using synthetic data
---

## What happened

Describe expected and actual behavior. Do not attach credentials, private source,
full prompts, or real run artifacts. Security-sensitive reports belong in the
private channel described in SECURITY.md.

## Environment

Skill version, operating system, Node version, npm version, and installed Pi
package versions. Include only redacted local doctor output.

## Minimal reproduction

Commands and synthetic input needed to reproduce the problem.

## Validation

Which of `npm test`, `npm run check:sdk`, and `npm run test:sdk` were executed?
Include the failing test and a redacted error, not a claim that unrun tests passed.
